name: qkd_embgw-sl2-4ca7b8091
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v4b slot cell qkd_embgw (1 instance, 388.776^2): the merged-die embedding gateway (HBM-held embedding table read through the four landing strips), wiring-only slot cell around ot_qkvd_embgw_m. 6,413 flops + 10,240 buffer bits (4 link FIFOs of 4 x 520 b, boot skid, request queue) = ~16.7 k sinks on one root: the --cts gate measures insertion / spread (clock rule, measured form).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_embgw u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_kv_gwhost_slots.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_embgw_m.sv rtl/qwen_sys/emb_hbm_20261008/synth/ot_qfd_emb_gw.sv rtl/qwen_sys/emb_hbm_20261008/synth/ot_qfd_emb_strip.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: slot_exact
bench.note: through the cell's own ports against 4 ot_qfd_emb_strip link ends + ideal PC model: boot load 2,580 sectors, 20 tokens / 40 fetches, 2,600 response words bit-exact

bench.name: slot_mutant
bench.note: OT_QKD_SLOT_MUT: t_eq data bits 100 / 101 swapped inside the cell: 1,281 wrong words

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_embgw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_embgw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_embgw --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_embgw  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: sl2: outline 172.8 x 216 instead of the 388.776^2 slot (first gate there: util 7 %, 16,646 sinks on one root at TT insertion 467.8 ps > 300 = refused by the clock rule): every flop within ~110 um of its face, tree depth set by the cell not the slot; every port on its own range, placed pin by pin (W 1,639 pins on 184 um, E 1,099, S 1,043, N 298).
